description: Thermal mass flow meter for gases: flow, total, temperature, status, gas selection and mixture, units and calibration check
notes: Modbus RTU on RS-485, address 1 to 247, 1200 to 115200 bps, parity none, odd or even; power the meter off and on after changing them. The meter can also use BACnet MS/TP (not described here).
Register numbers are those of the manual (40001 is the first holding register), counted from 1 (address_base 1). Function 04 reads the status at 40016 and 40017 too.
32-bit values take two registers, the least significant word first (the manual's LSW, then MSW).
Registers marked with * in the manual need firmware 8.3 or later. The gas selection codes (table 5.4) and the BACnet objects are not in this map.
Two mixture registers are both called 'Butano' in the manual (40074 and 40078); they are listed as first and second.
Written from the manufacturer's manual (Portuguese); not tested on a device.
